description: Product or checkout URLs return 404 as the agent's last request.
detection: Rule B16 (Broken link / 404) on the request log; evidence below.

recommendation.title: Broken link / 404: Fix links and add redirects for old URLs.
recommendation.body: Fix links and add redirects for old URLs.
recommendation.why_it_helps: Product or checkout URLs return 404 as the agent's last request.
recommendation.how_to_verify: 404 count on /p/ and /checkout paths falls to zero.
recommendation.verify_metric: Agent sessions ending with B16 per day
recommendation.llm_explanation: The AI shopping agents were blocked due to a broken link that resulted in a 404 error for the product page. Fixing this issue will improve the user experience and potentially increase conversion rates by ensuring that customers can access the product information they need.
